fitReason: RPAL offers a concrete physical manipulation direction: learned grasp-outcome prediction combined with graph-based planning and robot benchmarking. It is a narrower manipulation/perception match rather than a dedicated large-VLA group.

physicalEvidence.summary: The March 2025 Benchmarking Multi-Object Grasping paper evaluates actual UR5e systems with Robotiq 2F-85 or Barrett hands and RealSense D435 sensing. It explicitly reuses the group’s Only-Pick-Once and Experience Forest grasp algorithms. The original Only-Pick-Once primary source identifies its convolutional grasp-count predictor; the newer benchmark supplies recent physical validation. USF’s 2025 story independently locates multi-object grasping in Sun’s RPAL.

shortVisit.summary: A current official profile invites general project inquiries, without an explicit external-master’s/intern route. The 2025 Bridge Coalition record documents a ten-week University of Rhode Island undergraduate visit; it is programme-specific precedent, not a summer 2027 opening or graduate-visitor eligibility.

unknowns: Do not assign the collaborating Pisa/IIT SoftHand-2 setup to Sun’s USF lab without separate evidence. The 2025 paper mixes simulation and physical results: its scene-clearing protocol has human-only results, not robot completion.
The CNN mechanism dates to the 2023 primary paper, while the 2025 benchmark explicitly reuses it. This is learning-assisted grasp planning, not end-to-end foundation-model control.

The existing USF feasibility review says personal funds are supplementary and cannot be the sole source under the shared scholar workflow. Foreign-degree Student Intern is described, but category-specific funding application and eight-week timing need sponsor confirmation. Plan around the published three-to-six-month lead, not assumed immediate access.

The personal homepage and older RPAL member pages are partly stale or poorly extracted. Current title/email are corroborated by the official AI institute faculty page. Same-name authors at other universities and companies are not merged.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
